summary.intent: Execute Phase 60 of the CipherBox GSD workflow — 'IPNS Verification Cross-Layer Closeout' — implementing strict fail-closed IPNS verification across Rust (api-client, fuse, desktop) and TypeScript (sdk-core, API service) layers, organized into 4 dependency-ordered waves.
summary.outcome: Waves 1–2 completed cleanly (6/8 plans done): Rust verify chokepoint relocated and hardened, all 9 first-publish producers unified to seq=1, TS resolve path made strict, Rust consumers routed fail-closed, API strict regime enforced, and cross-language verify vectors regenerated. Wave 3 (60-06, verify cache) was in progress when the transcript ended; Wave 4 (60-08, staging cutover) awaits human action.

repo: crates/fuse/src/verify.rs was a re-export shim; 60-04 deleted it after 60-01 moved the real implementation into crates/api-client/src/ipns.rs — the module tree unlinked-file diagnostic is a stale snapshot artifact, not a real error.
IPNS first-publish producers (9 total across FUSE, desktop Tauri, sdk-core, web) were incorrectly embedding sequence 0; strict verifier requires sequence 1.

60-01 adding CBOR Validity parsing to api-client pulled in ciborium + cipherbox-core as new Cargo.toml deps, requiring a Cargo.lock update that the executor did not commit — a latent --locked CI break.
sdk-core has 251 tests with 34 ipns-specific tests; API ipns jest suite has 159 tests where ERROR lines are negative-path assertions (expected behavior, not failures).
Executor subagents can leave uncommitted artifacts (Cargo.lock updates, stray SUMMARY.md footer edits) that the orchestrator must detect and clean up between waves.
Wave 4 plan 60-08 is flagged non-autonomous (operational cutover: staging wipe + redeploy + smoke-test) and requires a human-action checkpoint.

code.finding: Had a VerifyError::Legacy reference that 60-01 folded to VerifyError::Invalid as a compile necessity; mid-executor diagnostic showed E0599 but grep confirmed zero Legacy refs remained in final state.
60-01 added ciborium and cipherbox-core as dependencies for CBOR Validity parsing; the executor committed Cargo.toml but not Cargo.lock — orchestrator committed the lockfile separately at 9fb576365.

workflow: Worktree isolation mode (Agent isolation='worktree') cannot reliably merge branches back to the feature branch in this harness — for safety-critical crypto phases, sequential gsd-executor subagents on the main working tree are the correct fallback.

The gsd commit helper has a documented false-negative: it returns 'No staged files match any configured task' even when the commit lands successfully — always verify with git log rather than treating the error as a real failure.
Post-wave build/test gates (cargo check across all touched crates + relevant jest/unit suites) are essential for catching cross-plan integration failures that per-plan scoped checks miss.

Executor subagents can legitimately deviate from their declared scope when compile necessity requires it (60-01 folded 9 FUSE Legacy arms that were nominally 60-04's scope); orchestrator must validate actual state rather than trusting declared scope boundaries.

friction: gsd commit helper false-negative caused unnecessary verification work — had to run git log to confirm 60-01 Cargo.lock commit actually landed at 9fb576365.
60-01 executor left Cargo.lock uncommitted, creating a latent --locked CI break that the orchestrator had to detect and remediate manually between waves.
60-01 executor appended a stray footer to 60-01-SUMMARY.md after its final commit, with factually wrong state (said 'verify.rs FOUND' after 60-04 deleted it) — required a manual revert.

Initial compile error diagnostic from 60-01 (E0599 VerifyError::Legacy in metadata.rs:619) was a stale mid-edit snapshot, requiring an extra grep + cargo check round-trip to confirm the tree was actually green.
Jest output for API ipns specs buried the pass/fail summary in log noise, requiring a second extraction command.

60-08 (Wave 4) — non-autonomous operational cutover: staging wipe, redeploy, and smoke-test against D-01/D-12; requires human execution and a manual checkpoint approval before phase can complete.
